Sword & Shield series · VIV

Vivid Voltage

Released November 13, 2020 · 203 cards

Expanded

Vivid Voltage is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on November 13, 2020. Its main set has 185 cards, plus 18 secret rares numbered beyond the set (203 in total). It includes 166 Pokémon, 33 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

75 illustrators worked on Vivid Voltage. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (20), aky CG Works (8), Sanosuke Sakuma (7), Ryuta Fuse (6), Hideki Ishikawa (5), kirisAki (4), kodama (4), Masakazu Fukuda (4).
